bodies.linkedin:
Users can achieve a pixel-perfect match to a Geojit PDF by modifying specific parameters in the configuration and report builder files.

The application converts financial context documents in PDF, CSV, or TXT formats into auto-filled PDF research reports. A quick start process can be completed in under 2 minutes.

The system utilizes two extraction paths. An optional LLM-based path is designed to degrade gracefully to a deterministic rule-based path if any errors occur during processing. Missing data fields are handled by rendering them as 'NA' and noting them on the report and in the API response.

ReportLab and matplotlib render the data into a PDF format. The project is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Jinja2, and pdfplumber.

This project is not affiliated with or produced by Geojit Financial Services Ltd. Reports generated by this tool are not considered investment advice.

claims.text: The web application converts financial context documents in PDF, CSV, or TXT formats into auto-filled PDF research reports.
The report template is a deliberate reconstruction of the Geojit research-report layout.
The application provides a quick start process that can be completed in under two minutes.
The system utilizes two extraction paths: an optional Claude-based LLM path and a default deterministic rule-based path.
The LLM extraction path is designed to degrade gracefully to the deterministic path if any errors occur during processing.
The application uses ReportLab and matplotlib to render ReportData into a PDF format.
Missing data fields are handled by rendering them as 'NA' and noting them on the report and in the API response.
The project is built using Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Jinja2, and pdfplumber.
The application uses a FastAPI-based structure with a Uvicorn launcher as the entry point.
Extraction logic is handled by a combination of deterministic heuristic rules and a Claude-based LLM.
Users can achieve a pixel-perfect match to a Geojit PDF by modifying specific parameters in the configuration and report builder files.
The project is not affiliated with or produced by Geojit Financial Services Ltd.
Reports generated by this tool are not considered investment advice.
